verdict.rationale: Crossplane is a Kubernetes-based infrastructure control plane, not an AI agent or assistant capable of consuming external tools; the evidence pack shows no agentic/LLM tool-use component that could plug in MCP servers to gain tool capabilities. The only AI-related mention (crossplane-docs-16) describes AI systems acting on Crossplane's APIs, the opposite direction of an MCP-client story, so this axis is a category error for this product type.
